stories.title: PwC Data Breach Claim – Everest Ransomware Group Claims to Have Stolen 590 GB of Data
stories.description: The Everest ransomware group claims to have stolen 590.69 GB of data linked to PwC, the global professional services firm. The alleged haul includes human resources records, training files, and internal documents.

stories.title: Critical Cisco Expressway Vulnerability Enables Remote Code Execution Attacks
stories.description: Cisco patched a critical Expressway flaw that could allow remote attackers to execute OS commands as root.

stories.title: Splunk Fixes 24 Security Flaws, Including Four Critical Vulnerabilities in Enterprise and SOAR
stories.description: Splunk patched 24 Enterprise and SOAR vulnerabilities, including four critical flaws involving RCE, DoS, and access control issues.

stories.title: Quest Diagnostics Hacked – Attackers Accessed the System to Order Tests and View Results
stories.description: Quest Diagnostics has disclosed a cyberattack involving unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system, which healthcare clients use to order laboratory tests and view results.

stories.title: eMudhra to Exit Global SSL/TLS Business After 8 Intermediate CA Keys Found Easily Guessable
